correctness.rationale: Unnormalized cube heat kernel is product Bernoulli with p=(1-e^{-2t})/2. Direct differentiation reduces the row absolute sum to e^{-2t} E|Bin(d,p)-dp|/(pq); telescoping yields the stated (d-1)-binomial mass. Stirling shift a={dp} gives B(t,a)=1/12+(6a(1-a)-1)/(12pq). The smooth leading g(t) has unique t*; uniform expansion plus nondegenerate maximum and selectable half-integer dp witnesses give two-term maximum and O(d^-1) localization/phase O(d^-1/2). Independently optimized near t* at d=200,1000,5000: correction tends toward b*=0.29250016, maximizing fractional part ≈0.5; exact kernel expansion vs finite values agrees. Numerical work is not asymptotic proof.
